pathAssistantSteps.info:
Checklist:

Ownership of the case: With Content Author


Based on the type value: Go to knowledge and either clone the article or amend an existing article to draft state before linking the article to this case.


Perform the rest of the updates on Knowledge article using the Article Steps below.

Please use the Change owner button to assign the case to your team member & follow the following matrix to firm up the priority/deadline of the case.

﻿

mark this step complete when you have set the priority/due date and assigned the case to content author.
Use the Email to communicate to the stakeholder and update the fields on your left to mark this case closed. Once done mark this step complete.

Click on the Article link to update the Date Category / Any Attachments / Promoted Search terms etc to the Article as your first step towards QA of the article. 

 Start the QA process by populating the details as per Step 3 below and continue the offline review and approval until validation status reached the last status of validated, which marks the completion of this journey step. 

 You also need to mark the milestone as complete which will stop the SLA clock.
Evaluate the request based on the subject and Description.
